context: Weekly check-in with a colleague. Nothing is due. Facts: the report is done, the next review is on 3 July, and the team has 6 people.

lines.text: Morning Hana, how was your weekend?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: Quiet, we walked by the sea and cooked dinner at home.
That sounds lovely, ours was rainy.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: The report is finished and I sent it to the team on Friday.
Good, thank you for finishing it.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: The next review is on the third of July, so we have time.
Yes, there is no rush this week.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: I think the six of us are in a good place right now.
I agree, the mood is good.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: I will take the afternoon off on Thursday for a dentist visit.
No problem, have a good week.
